headline: Callahan Held by Wardens as Shelf and Expanse Churn
war_summary: The hours since the 03:16 edition bring fresh turnover on several fronts while the Nevish Line falls silent. Callahan's Passage now stands ten Warden posts with seventeen changes on the day, including two in the last two hours to 05:34, and day losses of 10,873 Colonial and 11,782 Warden. Nevish records no changes in two hours after eight in six to 01:58, holding at fifty-six on the day about six Warden and two Colonial posts with 4,073 and 4,245 losses. The Weathered Expanse quickens with five changes in two hours and forty on the day to 05:16, counting five Colonial and four unheld posts with 5,107 and 8,675 losses. Stlican Shelf reports five changes in two hours to 05:57 for thirteen on the day at two Warden and seven Colonial, while Stonecradle adds five in two hours to 05:45 for ten on the day at the same division. Palantine Berm and Mooring County fall silent in two hours, the former at thirty-seven on the day about seven Warden posts last heard at 00:59.
